name: MySQL
description: Bounded MySQL prepared queries, transactions, safe row operations, schema and catalog discovery, with an embedded MySQL2 client.

permissions.description: Connects by TCP/TLS only to explicit MySQL target. Uses encrypted MYSQL_PASSWORD or configured password/CA secret names or selected profile password. LONG_PASSWORD and MYSQL_CLEAR_PASSWORD_NOT_ENABLED are conservatively declared upstream protocol/error identifiers for the static audit; neither is looked up as an ONF secret. Bundled MySQL2 has no external dependencies, filesystem/ambient configuration fallback, native addon or remote installation. All operations prohibit retries; queries capable of effects and mutations require explicit confirmation.

definitions.name: MySQL Parameterized Query (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Parameterized Query. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Execute Statement (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Execute Statement. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Bounded Transaction (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Bounded Transaction. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Explain Query (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Explain Query. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Select Rows (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Select Rows. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Insert Row (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Insert Row. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Upsert Row (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Upsert Row. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Update Matching Rows (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Update Matching Rows. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Delete Matching Rows (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Delete Matching Rows. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Connection Health (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Connection Health. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Server Information (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Server Information. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Session Information (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Session Information. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Schemas (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Schemas. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Tables (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Tables. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Views (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Views. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Columns (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Columns. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Indexes (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Indexes. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Constraints (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Constraints. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Routines (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Routines. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
List Routine Parameters. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Triggers (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Triggers. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Engines (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Engines. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Character Sets (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Character Sets. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Collations (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Collations. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Partitions (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Partitions. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL List Events (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Events. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL View Information (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
View Information. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Table Statistics (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Table Statistics. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Schema Statistics (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Schema Statistics. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Session Status (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Session Status. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: MySQL Session Variables (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Session Variables. One TCP/TLS connection with embedded mysql2 3.24.6, verified TLS by default, explicit encrypted password/CA secrets or selected profile.config and profile.credentials.password. Prepared parameter binding, static parsers, ordered duplicate-safe fields/rows; decimal, bigint, JSON and temporal text retain precision, binary uses explicit hex. Query/Explain and writes require confirm=true; all operations retries=0. Inspection uses READ ONLY. Transaction accepts restricted statement kinds; conservative lexical unsupported-feature checks are not a SQL security sandbox. Database privileges and disabled driver filesystem/local-infile capabilities remain authoritative. No DDL, CALL, session controls, pools or replication. Read-only does not stop every external effect of UDFs or views; apply least privilege. Prepare complete bounded returned output before COMMIT; control acknowledgements have separate budgets. 512 KiB requests, 64 KiB SQL, 1000 params, 50 statements, up to 10000 rows/1 MiB results; rejects overflow with no truncation. Total deadline up to 60s; independent 250ms cleanup cap with socket destroy. TLS trust and DNS/IP hostname verification required when enabled. Native Buffer encodings only; unsupported result encodings fail closed. MySQL native auth, caching SHA2 fast auth, full SHA2/SHA256 only on TLS; no clear-password plugin or fetched server RSA keys. Synthetic wire validation proves embedded mechanism only, not real SQL/server privileges. Sources: https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs https://sidorares.github.io/node-mysql2/docs/documentation/prepared-statements https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/tree/v3.24.6 https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/information-schema.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/implicit-commit.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/function-resolution.html https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_connection_phase.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.
